stories.title: Transport Corp announces key details for Rs 150 crore share buyback plan

en.title: GIFT City eyes direct listings without IPO to deepen equity market, says IFSCA's Pradeep Ramakrishnan
en.summary: IFSCA plans to introduce a direct-listing framework at GIFT City within months, enabling companies to list shares without traditional IPOs. The initiative aims to strengthen GIFT IFSC's equity market alongside its existing bond and sustainable finance operations.
